documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of The Un-Audited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026
Intimation About Receipt Of Approval For Enhancement In Manufacturing Capacity Of Ethanol Plant
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong financial performance for FY 2025-26, with revenue from operations increasing to Rs. 1,01,015.78 Lakh and net profit growing to Rs. 6,991.41 Lakh. The company successfully completed the commercial operations of its grain-based ethanol plant and received capacity enhancement approvals. Management observed favourable market trends across segments like textiles, packaging, and clean energy, despite geopolitical uncertainties and volatile crude-derived raw material prices.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the overall acrylic fibre market is projected to rise at 3.5% to 4.00% CAGR till 2035.
guidance.quote: With the rapid growth of the apparel & textile industry and increasing usage of acrylic fibres for making apparel, the overall acrylic fibre market is projected to rise at 3.5% - 4.00% CAGR till 2035.

guidance.claim: Management noted that the global market for CPP packaging films is expected to reach US$ 8,742.2 Mn by 2033, growing at a 5% CAGR till 2033.
guidance.quote: The global market for CPP packaging films is expected to reach US$ 8,742.2 Mn by 2033, growing at a 5% CAGR till 2033.

guidance.claim: Management noted that the global ethanol market is anticipated to register a CAGR of 6.8% from 2023 to 2032.
guidance.quote: The global ethanol market is anticipated to register a CAGR of 6.8% from 2023 to 2032.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the demand for acrylic fibers is anticipated to rise in the coming years due to macroeconomic development of end-use sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand for acrylic fibers is anticipated to rise in the coming years, particularly due to the macroeconomic development of end-use sectors which is supported by regional GDP and population growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that with rising packaging requirements across sectors, the CPP films industry is projected to expand at a robust rate.
demand_outlook.quote: With the rising requirement for packaging across sectors, with traditional businesses preferring to package products, and the retail and e-commerce growing rapidly, the CPP films industry is projected to expand at a robust rate.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the ethanol market has potential to grow beyond transportation, presenting new opportunities in various industrial applications.
demand_outlook.quote: The ethanol market has potential to grow beyond transportation, presenting new opportunities in aviation biofuels, bio-based chemicals, power generation and industrial applications for producers.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that India is expected to account for a substantial share of the global acrylic fibre market due to rapid textile industry expansion.
demand_outlook.quote: According to Future Market Insights (FMI), India is expected to account for a substantial share of the global acrylic fibre market, owing to the rapid expansion of the textiles industry and the rise in the export of yarns and fibres.

demand_outlook.claim: The overall acrylic fibre market is projected to rise at a 4.2% CAGR till 2035.
demand_outlook.quote: With the rapid growth of the apparel & textile industry and increasing usage of acrylic fibres for making apparel, the overall acrylic fibre market is projected to rise at 4.2% CAGR till 2035.

demand_outlook.claim: The global market for CPP packaging films is expected to reach US$ 8,742.2 Mn by 2033, growing at a 4.2% CAGR till 2033.
demand_outlook.quote: The global market for CPP packaging films is expected to reach US$ 8,742.2 Mn by 2033, growing at a 4.2% CAGR till 2033.

demand_outlook.claim: The global ethanol market is anticipated to register a CAGR of 6.8% from 2023 to 2032.
demand_outlook.quote: The global ethanol market is anticipated to register a CAGR of 6.8% from 2023 to 2032.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for packaged foods is at an all-time high due to growing world population.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand for packaged foods is at an all-time high due to growing world population.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the overall acrylic fibre market is projected to rise at a 3.9% CAGR between 2023 and 2033.
demand_outlook.quote: With the rapid growth of the apparel & textile industry and increasing usage of acrylic fibres for making apparel, the overall acrylic fibre market is projected to rise at 3.9% CAGR between 2023 and 2033.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the company successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based ethanol plant and commenced commercial production in March, 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant and commenced commercial production in March, 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: Management reported receiving consents from respective departments to enhance ethanol plant capacity from 150 KL per day to 180 KL per day.
capex_expansion.quote: Subsequently, the Company had filed an application with the concerned departments to enhance the capacity from 150 KL per day to 180 KL per day due to improve operational efficiency and the Company has received the consents from the respective departments/ authorities in this regard.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has spent around Rs. 188 Crore so far which includes Rs. 104 Crore of Term Loan and Balance amount out of internal accruals.
capex_expansion.quote: Company has spent around Rs. 188 Crore so far which includes Rs. 104 Crore of Term Loan and Balance amount out of internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: The total project cost for the ethanol project is Rs. 167.58 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The total Project cost is Rs. 167.58 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that various cost optimizations led to significant savings during the year under review.
margins_costs.quote: Various cost optimisation driven by way of alternate sourcing, standardization, process improvements and operational efficiency improvements has led significant savings.

margins_costs.claim: Loss of CPP has been declined due to better realization and reduction in overheads.
margins_costs.quote: During the year under review, loss of CPP has been declined due to better realization and reduction in overheads.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue and net profit declined due to lower demand and negative returns on the CPP segment caused by a persistent fall in selling prices.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue and Net profit during the year declined due to lower demand of acrylic fibre and negative return on CPP Segment caused by persistent fall in selling prices on account of excessive production capacity added in the market.

margins_costs.claim: The fluctuation in crude oil affects raw material prices to some extent, and crude prices remained volatile due to conflicts.
margins_costs.quote: The fluctuation in crude affects the raw material prices to some extent and during the year under the review, the crude prices remained volatile due to conflict in Israel-Hamas War & Russia-Ukraine War.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported that the production capacity to produce acrylic products of the company is 42,000 MT PA.
orders_capacity.quote: The production capacity to produce Acrylic products of the Company is 42,000 MT PA.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the company's production capacity to produce CPP film is 10,000 MT PA.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company’s production capacity to produce CPP film is 10000 MT PA.

orders_capacity.claim: Management noted that during the year under review, the company recorded acrylic fibre production of 35,212 MT and sales of 37,878 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 35,212 MT and sale of 37,878 MT, as against production of 35,198 MT and sale of 33,850 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported that the production and sale of CPP film was 7,545 MT and 7,621 MT respectively during the year under review.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the production and sale of CPP film was 7,545 MT and 7,621 MT respectively as against production and sale of 6,343 MT and 6,409 MT respectively during the previous year with an increase of 18.95% and 18.91% in production and sales respectively over the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that production and sale of ethanol was 41,923 KL and 41,162 KL respectively during the year under review.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the production and sale of Ethanol was 41,923 KL and 41,162 KL respectively as against production and sale of 790 KL and 440 KL respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 35,198 MT and Sale of 33,850 MT of Acrylic Fibre.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 35,198 MT and Sale of 33,850 MT, as against production of 31,534 MT and Sale of 31,685 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: During the year under review, the production and sale of CPP film was 6,343 MT and 6,409 MT respectively.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the production and sale of CPP film was 6,343 MT and 6,409 MT respectively as against production of 6,463 MT and sale of 6,476 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: During the year under review, the production and sale of Ethanol was 790 KL and 440 KL respectively.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the production and sale of Ethanol was 790 KL and 440 KL respectively.

orders_capacity.claim: During the year, the company recorded production of 31,534 MT and sales of 31,685 MT for acrylic fibre.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 31,534 MT and Sale of 31,685 MT, as against production of 36,425 MT and Sale of 35,260 MT respectively during the previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: During the year under review the Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review the Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors of your company, has decided not to transfer any amount to the General Reserve for the year ended 31st March, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of your company, has decided not to transfer any amount to the General Reserve for the year ended 31st March, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2023-24 as internal accruals are being utilized to set up the ethanol plant.
capital_allocation.quote: As the Company’s internal accruals is being utilized to set-up Ethanol Plant, the Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2023-24.

capital_allocation.claim: Indian Bank sanctioned a term loan of Rs. 108 crores for the ethanol project.
capital_allocation.quote: Indian Bank had sanctioned Term Loan of Rs. 108 Crores and as per stipulations of sanction letter, the remaining project cost of Rs. 59.58 would be met out of the Company’s internal accruals.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that global acrylic fibre consumption is impacted by volatility in prices of raw materials, energy, coal, and other key inputs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Global Acrylic Fibre consumption is impacted due to volatility in prices of raw material, energy, coal and other key inputs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that crude price fluctuations affect raw material prices and remain volatile due to geopolitical conflicts.
risks_headwinds.quote: The raw material to produce the Company’s products is crude derived. The fluctuation in crude affects the raw material prices to some extent and during the year under the review, the crude prices remained volatile due to conflict in US/Israel-Iran War & Russia-Ukraine War.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that fluctuations in foreign exchange rates between USD and INR have a bearing on the company's margins due to import dependence.
risks_headwinds.quote: Additionally, since the Company is dependent upon imports, the fluctuation in foreign exchange i.e. USD vs. INR has also a bearing on the margin of the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that ethanol prices are determined by oil marketing companies and the company has no control over them.
risks_headwinds.quote: The prices of ethanol products are determined by Oil Marketing Companies (“OMC”) and the Company has no control on the prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: The fluctuation in crude affects the raw material prices to some extent and during the year under the review, the crude prices remained volatile due to conflict in Israel-Hamas War & Russia-Ukraine War.
risks_headwinds.quote: The fluctuation in crude affects the raw material prices to some extent and during the year under the review, the crude prices remained volatile due to conflict in Israel-Hamas War & Russia-Ukraine War.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that geopolitical tensions, supply chain disruptions, subdued global conditions, and intense competition are key risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geo-political tensions including supply chain disruption, subdued global economic conditions, changes in government policies and trade sanctions and restrictions, intense competition from local and global players, regulatory changes and cyber security threats are key risks which expose the Company to potential challenges and uncertainties.

risks_headwinds.claim: Since the company depends on imported raw materials, USD movements and rising crude oil prices may affect margins.
risks_headwinds.quote: Further, since the Company is dependent upon imported raw materials, movement in USD and increase in crude oil prices due to ongoing Israel-Hamas war and Russia-Ukraine war may affect the margin.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company is exploring possibilities of increasing exports and is hopeful to achieve better exports in the coming years.
management_commitments.quote: The Company has exported to Algeria, Kenya, Peru, Ukraine, Morocco, Tunisia, Ethiopia, Nepal etc. and is exploring possibilities of increasing exports and it is hopeful to achieve better exports in the coming years.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to commence commercial production of ethanol by September 2024.
management_commitments.quote: Further, the Company has already initiated steps to establish grain based Ethanol Project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD and it is expected to commence commercial production of Ethanol by September, 2024.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
